app.name: FairShift
app.tagline: A fair, transparent queue for extra shifts. No more racing to reply first.

rules.order: Your place depends only on when you joined, by the server's clock.
rules.slots: When a manager publishes a shift with N slots, the first N available people in the queue get it at once. There's nothing to accept.
rules.after_shift: After your shift you can rejoin, always at the end of the queue.
rules.pause: Unavailable (e.g. holidays): you keep your place, but shifts skip you.
rules.cancel: If a shift is cancelled, you go back to your original place.
rules.give_back: You can give a shift back before it starts. The next person gets it; you can rejoin at the end.
rules.no_reorder: Nobody, not even managers, can reorder the queue. Every change is logged.
rules.privacy: Colleagues never see your name. Only managers do.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: FairShift is built to collect as little personal data as possible (GDPR / LGPD).

who.title: Who is responsible
who.body: Your hospital decides how FairShift is used and is the data controller. FairShift processes data on its behalf.

what.title: What we collect
what.body: Your name, e-mail address, preferred language, your profession (doctor or nurse), when you joined and left the queue, the shifts assigned to you, notification settings and device push tokens. We don't collect location, contacts or health data.

why.title: Why
why.body: Only to run a fair, first-come-first-served queue for extra shifts per profession, to tell you when a shift is assigned to you, and to keep an audit log so every decision can be checked.

visibility.title: Who can see it
visibility.body: Your hospital's managers see names, professions and positions. Colleagues see only their own position and how many people are in their queue, never names. Hospitals can never see each other's data.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: While your account exists. The audit log is append-only and is kept to prove fairness; if you delete your account your entries in it become anonymous.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can download a copy of your data and delete your account from Settings at any time. To correct your profession or other data, contact a manager at your hospital.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about how your hospital uses FairShift should go to your hospital's data protection officer.
